name: Accredo Specialty Pharmacy
notes: Tier 2. Accredo (Evernorth/Cigna) has its own patient portal (accredo.evernorth.com: Patient Log In, My Account, My Medications, Make a Payment, Register) separate from express-scripts.com, which is the tier-1 Express Scripts Pharmacy dossier. Researched from the public accredo.com Frequently Asked Questions page and its 'How do I pay for my specialty medications?' article (no sign-in). Payment: debit or credit card (American Express, Discover, MasterCard, Visa), checking account or FSA, through the Accredo app or website, or a mailed check to Accredo Health, Inc., PO Box 954041, St. Louis, MO 63195. Copay assistance cards are added under Payment Methods in the profile. Cost is shared during the order scheduling call; delivery has no extra charge. Phone 800-803-2523 (Hawaii 808-650-6488); new prescriptions are faxed to 888-302-1028. The app lists Pay balances. AutoPay, guest payment, payment plans and paperless billing are not described on the public pages (unsupported, inferred); the Billing & Payments line 866-943-9044 (Mon-Fri 7am-6pm CT) is listed on the public accredo.com Contact Us page. Review 2026-10-10: re-verified the Billing & Payments line 866-943-9044 and the Digital Support line 866-725-2546 on the public Contact Us page; added contact.payPhone, pay_by_phone (documented_official) and the billing line in the payment-plan note and the contact article.

guest_pay.note: Log in to your Accredo web or app profile to pay (register first if you don't have one), or mail a check to Accredo Health, Inc., PO Box 954041, St. Louis, MO 63195. Billing questions: 866-943-9044.

autopay.note: Accredo does not offer automatic payments online. Your cost is reviewed with you when each order is scheduled, and you pay through the app or website.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not set up online. Call Billing & Payments at 866-943-9044 (Monday to Friday, 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. CT) to talk about your balance, and use the Copay Assistance search to look for savings programs.

paperless.note: There is no paperless-billing setting. Your balance is shown in your Accredo web or app profile, and refill reminders and order updates can come by email or text.

scheduled_payment.note: Payments are made right away; future-dated payments are not offered online.

help.title: Paying for your specialty medications
paragraphs: Pay through the Accredo app or website with a debit or credit card (American Express, Discover, MasterCard or Visa), your checking account, or a flexible spending account (FSA). The app shows your current balance and lets you pay it.

You can also mail a check to Accredo Health, Inc., PO Box 954041, St. Louis, MO 63195. Your cost is shared with you during the phone call when your order is scheduled, and delivery has no extra shipping or handling charge.
steps: Patient Log In to accredo.com or the Accredo app.
Pick a card, checking account or FSA card.

help.title: Copay assistance
paragraphs: Use Accredo's Copay Assistance search tool to look for financial assistance programs for your medication. If you are already enrolled in copay assistance, give the details during the call to schedule your first order, or add them under Payment Methods in your Accredo web or app profile; they will then be applied to your orders.

help.title: Getting started and refills
paragraphs: Ask your doctor to send a new prescription to Accredo; a patient care advocate calls you to schedule delivery. If you already have a prescription, log in to your Express Scripts account and open your medications; prescriptions you can manage at Accredo show a button that takes you to the Accredo website.

Refill through the Accredo website or app (you can set reminders by email or text), or call 800-803-2523 (Hawaii: 808-650-6488). New medications usually take five to seven days; refills usually arrive in 24 to 48 hours. If you are out of refills, your doctor can fax a new prescription to 888-302-1028.

help.title: Contact Accredo
paragraphs: Refills and orders: 800-803-2523, Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. and Saturday 7 a.m. to 4 p.m. CT (Hawaii residents 808-650-6488). Call this line for order problems, questions for a pharmacist, or to tell Accredo your payment method has changed.
Billing and payments: 866-943-9044, Monday to Friday 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. CT. Help with the Accredo website or app: 866-725-2546. TTY users dial 711, available around the clock.
Condition-specific lines are also available, for example Oncology 877-732-3431 and Bleeding Disorders 866-712-5200. To start texting, text Start to 877-222-7336.
